AfterSideTurnStart.rationale: Candelabra.cs:23-30 gains EnergyVar(2).BaseValue when the owner is among the turn's participants and PlayerCombatState.TurnNumber == 2; candelabra.py:19-21 is the same branch with the same constant. The slot is right and was checked by execution rather than off relics/base.py's docstring (PROMPT.md bug class 11): `py tools/audit/relic_probes.py turn-order` prints on_block_cleared -> on_energy_reset -> on_player_turn_start -> modify_hand_draw -> on_player_turn_started, so on_player_turn_started is the post-draw slot that audits/seam/turn_structure.json step 23 assigns to AfterSideTurnStart. Placement after the energy reset (step 17) is what makes the +2 stick rather than being overwritten.

guards.rationale: The `player != base.Owner` / `card.Owner != base.Owner` / `participants.Contains(base.Owner.Creature)` family is the multiplayer per-player filter on a hook the game dispatches for every player (and, for the participants form, also admits pets). The sim is single-player by construction (one RunState, one PlayerCombatState) and models no pet creature, so the filter is structurally satisfied. Multiplayer-only paths are out of scope under the shared contract.

audits/seam/turn_structure.json's extra-turn step settles this: CombatState.turn increments once per player turn including extra turns, which is what PlayerCombatState.TurnNumber does too (only RoundNumber diverges), and that record explicitly lists the ported turn-number readers -- Horn Cleat turn 2, Captain's Wheel turn 3, Sparkling Rouge turn 3, Royal Poison turn 1, Anchor turn 1 -- as all reading TurnNumber, 'which is what self.turn models'. Candelabra is the same shape. One verdict per mechanism (binding rule 3).

Checked deliberately because relic/booming_conch's direct `player.energy = ...` IS a recorded gap for skipping this exact chain. PlayerCmd.GainEnergy (PlayerCmd.cs:29-43) guards amount <= 0 and IsEnding, runs Hook.ModifyEnergyGain, then AfterModifyingEnergyGain, then adds. EnergyCmd.gain (cmds.py:547-553) runs hooks.modify_energy_gain and adds. The only missing leg is AfterModifyingEnergyGain, which is the same missing-companion-event shape as relic/bag_of_preparation's N1 and belongs to the hook layer, not to this relic. The two guards are structurally satisfied (the amount is a constant 2, and a combat hook cannot fire while the combat is ending). Rule 7: PlayerCmd.cs and cmds.py are not hashed here.
